description: Read the daily system backup of a VPS: whether it runs (enabled), when the customer switched it off, next and last run (null without a ZapX Pass with backups) and canSwitchOff. Read-only: switching it off or on is only possible in the dashboard or via the REST API. Fails when daily backups are not available for this VPS. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: get_vserver_daily_backup
title: Get VPS Daily Backup
